overview_description.description: Akeana provides RISC-V processor IP and system solutions, including multi-core processors, interconnects, and hardware accelerators. Its offerings cover in-order, out-of-order, and multi-threading architectures with advanced security, telemetry, and power management. Users can access fully customizable IP for applications from embedded devices to data centers, automotive, cloud, and AI workloads.
